items.title: Albert Artigues Sr. Interview, 1961-12-15
items.q: Henry Wilder had a good band in there with the Mellon Pickers. Raymond played with them.

ctx.x: I don't think they would be reading much, either.

They weren't reading. They'd all come from here. That's what I'm telling you. And boy, they had guys used to come around there from all over and sit out and listen at that band. And the way they had that ringside pattern, the acoustics in that band was like they were playing in a jewel box. Perfect. They had the whole ringside patterned, you know. And man, the sound in there was perfect. You know, they had a good band in there, too. Henry Wilder had a good band in there with the Mellon Pickers. Raymond played…
Who else was in the Mellon Pickers?
